notes.title: v1.0.2 Patch - Fixed Interaction and Navigation Problems
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue in the torii gate area where the player could climb where they shouldn't and fall off the walkway.
・Adjustments have been made to help mitigate a bug that could prevent interaction with certain doors. Full resolution is still being worked on.
